rooms.name: Hall
rooms.description: The main entrance of the campus. Students come and go through the glass doors.

rooms.name: Bocal
rooms.description: The staff office, full of screens and paperwork. Everyone calls it the Bocal.

rooms.name: Cluster
rooms.description: Rows of iMacs hum quietly. Students stare at their code in silence.

rooms.name: Break Room
rooms.description: Old sofas and a vending machine. A good place to rest between two projects.

rooms.name: Lunch Room
rooms.description: Long tables and a row of microwaves. Something scuttles under the fridge.

rooms.name: Snacking Area
rooms.description: Shelves of snacks and a coffee machine that never stops.

rooms.name: Cluster 2
rooms.description: A second cluster, quieter than the first. Someone left a terminal open.

rooms.name: Gaming Room
rooms.description: Consoles, arcade cabinets and a lot of shouting.

rooms.name: Outside
rooms.description: The courtyard in front of the campus. Bikes are chained to the railings.

rooms.name: Grass
rooms.description: A patch of grass where students eat lunch when the sun is out.

rooms.name: Smoking Area
rooms.description: A bench and an ashtray, a little away from the entrance.

rooms.name: Parking
rooms.description: Rows of cars and scooters. The road to the city starts here.

items.name: Coffee
items.description: A hot cup of coffee. Restores 30 HP.

items.name: USB Key
items.description: A USB key with a Bocal sticker on it.

items.name: Signed Form
items.description: A form signed by a peer tutor, addressed to the security guard.

items.name: Broom
items.description: Not a sword, but it will do against a cockroach.

items.name: Vending Machine
items.description: Far too heavy to carry. It hums softly.

items.name: Meal Ticket
items.description: A free meal, offered by the Bocal.

items.name: Cleaning Gloves
items.description: Thick gloves from the janitor. Nothing bites through them.

items.name: Locker Key
items.description: The key to a locker in the hall, given by the peer tutor.

npcs.name: Security Guard
npcs.description: A stern guard checks every badge at the entrance.
dialogue: The clusters are upstairs, past the Bocal.
Nothing to report at the entrance.

npcs.name: Bocal Staff
npcs.description: A staff member types fast, surrounded by three screens.
dialogue: I lost my USB key somewhere in the Cluster.

npcs.name: Peer Tutor
npcs.description: A student helps others without looking up from the screen.
dialogue: Stuck on your project? Ask a peer.
Could you bring this form to the Security Guard?

npcs.name: Janitor
npcs.description: He leans on his cart and sighs at the mess.
dialogue: A giant cockroach lives in the Lunch Room.
Don't touch the vending machine, it eats coins.

npcs.name: Giant Cockroach
npcs.description: A cockroach the size of a cat, with shiny brown wings.

quests.description: Find my USB Key in the Cluster and bring it back to the Bocal.
Chase the Giant Cockroach out of the Lunch Room, twice.
Bring the Signed Form to the Security Guard in the Hall.
